name: package_prerequisite
description: A deliverable blocked by an upgraded package (tiny_tasks, served from a local git repository) whose model coalesces a timestamp with a source column that arrives all NULL and typed integer. The source is delivered by an ingestion vendor, so the project can adapt but cannot change the data. Contrasting requests: adapt the project, or modify the data (which Dex cannot do here, so that part must be reported).
